positive: Original source camera/240Hz, original road and B51 HUD remained pixel-identical when diagnostic OFF at all 3 frames.
WebGL2 true source depth rendered all four R47 flat proxy components with nonzero impact at all three 240Hz ticks, and per-component skip/restore matched.
Compared with previous invisibility issues, proxy shapes can indeed be placed on the left source frame in this original camera without editing the source original game.
vetoReasons: Even at the middle 66.35s, the visible study consists of a narrow cyan/white horizontal polygon and an isolated orange slab beside the left side of the road. It does not communicate falling water, a receiving pool, or a working hydraulic gate.

Original real WebGL screenshots do not communicate temporal three-act source→fall+gate→receiver causal progression; all four diagnostic elements influence the picture at every sampled tick, and perceptual significance is not stage-specific.

The middle waterfall influence box is only about 92x29 screen pixels; the headrace early bbox is 95x9 and receiver late bbox 120x26. Presence of pixels is not enough to read a water-level drop and downstream receiver at 183-184m/s.
An ungrounded flat gate proxy is not a mechanically supported actuator, and the study has no physically connected source underbank intake. Labeling these art-success would violate V15.
criticalHumanVisualAssessment.interpretation: R47's sequential screen-pixel preflight predicts renderable masks but does not validate causal visual semantics in source-original WebGL2. A future full DCC generated solely from this geometry would likely repeat R44/R39 flat-water and decorative slab failure modes; there is insufficient evidence to justify it.
